diagram_math_checks.relation: For each s, retain pi_k(s) if it maximizes Q_k(s,·); otherwise choose the earliest maximizing action in the supplied order.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Exactly Definition step 2. Finite nonempty A(s) gives an attained maximum; the input list contains each action once, so earliest maximizer exists uniquely. Retention explicitly includes tied maximizers. These choices again form a deterministic policy.

diagram_math_checks.relation: Equality branch returns (pi_k,V_k); inequality branch increments k and enters the current-policy box.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Exactly Definition step 3. The equality test is global policy equality, following all statewise updates; the unequal branch uses the newly computed pi_{k+1} after incrementing k. For empty S, all statewise choices are vacuous and the unique empty policies compare equal, so the same flow returns immediately.
